newsitem.title: USA: CapStar to buy Philadelphia Embassy Suites.
newsitem.headline: CapStar to buy Philadelphia Embassy Suites.

text.p: CapStar Hotel Co said Monday it had signed an agreement to acquire the 288-suite Embassy Suites Center City hotel in Philadelphia from an affiliate of Philadelphia-based Atlantic American Properties Trust.
In a press release, CapStar said it expects the transaction to close within 30 days.
Company officials were not available to give details on the transaction.
CapStar said that on completion of the deal, it will invest about $2.6 million dollars to renovate the hotel.
